title: tier-2 shipped code: the inverse wish transform against MoverWishInverse (0x140cb5350)
notes: SHIPPED-CODE tier-2 unit. The candidate is crates/ow-sim/src/movement.rs (inverse_transform), called by crates/ow-sim/src/bin/verify_probe.rs through the mover_wish_inverse entry.

The oracle starts at 0x140cb537b, after FUN_140cb83b0's TEST/JZ. RBX holds the vector, [RSP+0x30] holds c0 and the rest of the matrix follows; the unit seeds RBX from arg0, RSP=0x7FFF0000EF20 and the 16-float matrix in the state block at RSP+0x30.

The matrix is fixed (the state block is fixed) and generic: c0=(0.5,0.25,0.125,0), c1=(-0.25,0.5,0,0), c2=(0.125,-0.125,0.5,0), c3=(1.5,-2.25,0.75,1); det = 39/256 exactly. The vector varies across the 264 cases.

The SIMD sequence is transcribed lane for lane: SHUFPS, MULPS, SUBPS, the horizontal det sum (lane1+lane0)+lane2, rcpps, (2-rcp*det)*rcp, the row broadcasts, the sign-mask XOR and the final add. The Unicorn rcpps used by the oracle probes as exact IEEE 1/x.
The two image reads are the (2,2,2,2) constant at 0x1431107f0 and the 0x80000000 sign mask at 0x14328cd50.
acknowledgedGaps: The matrix is fixed because per-case state overlays are not supported by the harness; a varying-matrix unit needs a wider fixture or a state extension. The block's initial FUN_140cb83b0 state lookup and its TEST/JZ failure path are not covered (the unit starts after them).
